journal.title: The question beneath physics
journal.p: Leibniz’s question — why is there something rather than nothing? — is not retired by a successful cosmological model. Models describe a world that is already given.
When popular writing says the universe came from “nothing,” check whether the word still names a vacuum, a law, or a formalism. Those are somethings. The metaphysical question remains on the table.
